scope: Three static REA dossiers for actual CommonFunction ordinals3,8,9 selected by prior Open/SetEkey. Ordinary PE vtable/RTTI sidecar. No DLL/media/cache execution, user-state reads, production changes, or Git operations.

method.provider: Ghidra12.1.4 via independent REA CLI processes
method.snapshot_sources: Matched CommonFunction hash/binding in qq-sign-next-snapshot.json before cloning.

observations.evidence: Ordinal3 calls FUN_1000bae1 with48, stores returned pointer inESI, writes vtable1000ea2c at object+0 and zeros+4/+8/+c/+28/+2c. It zeroes24 bytes at+0x10 and calls InitializeCriticalSectionAndSpinCount(object+0x10,0). Failure obtains GetLastError, may form HRESULT and calls nonreturning FUN_100015c0 for negative error. Normal exit returns ESI inEAX with RET0xc. No caller stack argument is read/written in this factory body. VMProtectBeginMutation/CreateStreamEncAndDec and VMProtectEnd calls bracket it.

Ordinal8 calls FUN_1000bae1 with12, writes vtable1000e760 at object+0 and zeros DWORDs+4/+8. It returns ESI inEAX and RET4. The status pointer passed by QQMusicCommon callers is not read/written in this body. VMProtectBeginMutation/CreateKeyDec and VMProtectEnd calls bracket it.

Ordinal9 loads its sole stack argument intoECX. If nonnull, it loads object vtable, pushes1 and calls vtable+4 using ECX as object. It then VMProtectEnd and RET4. Null skips the virtual call. The virtual leaf is not expanded; deallocation behavior cannot be proved from the wrapper alone.

Hash-pinned ordinary PE reads confirm vtable1000ea2c at fileoffset0xd02c has RTTI.?AVStreamCencrypt@@ through COL1000f408/type100113cc, COL offset0. Vtable1000e760 at fileoffset0xcd60 has RTTI.?AVKeyDec@@ through COL1000f000/type10011150, COL offset0. These are static bytes, not runtime object observations or REA evidence IDs.

observations.topic: Concrete methods selected by previous callers
observations.evidence: KeyDec vtable+0 contains100053c0, the actual target of prior SetEkey/Open key-pointer,length calls. KeyDec vtable+4 contains10005380, the actual ordinal9 nonnull virtual target. StreamCencrypt vtable+8 contains100097a0, the actual prior key-object handoff target. StreamCencrypt vtable+0x10 contains10009a20, the actual prior Read mode2 position/buffer/length target. All four are backed by executable.text bytes; no leaf behavior is yet analyzed.

Sidecar captured6 stream pointers and3 raw key table-adjacent DWORDs. The third key raw DWORD1000efcc is not executable and must not be treated as another key virtual method. Captured counts do not prove total vtable length.

derived_inferences.claim: QQMusicCommon mode2's key interface is concretely implemented by KeyDec, and its stream interface by StreamCencrypt in this CommonFunction binary.
derived_inferences.basis: Actual Common caller GetProcAddress ordinals, factory vtable writes, original vtable DWORDs and RTTI agree.
derived_inferences.limit: Class names do not prove algorithms, formats, valid keys, successful decoding or remote source ownership.

derived_inferences.claim: Ordinal9 virtual+4(flag1) is consistent with a scalar-deleting destructor convention.
derived_inferences.basis: ECX object, one flag argument and virtual+4 release wrapper.
derived_inferences.limit: FUN10005380 body is unexpanded; do not claim heap cleanup implementation from ABI pattern alone.
